common.note: Generic label, likely used as a callout/alert heading (e.g. 'Note:'), not a verb.
common.default: Generic badge/value meaning 'this is the default option', not a 'reset to default' button.
common.all: Generic filter/dropdown option meaning no filter is applied (show everything), not a 'select all' action.
common.none: Generic value meaning 'nothing selected/configured', not a negative reply.
common.on: Toggle-state label (power/enabled state), not the preposition 'on'.
common.off: Toggle-state label (power/disabled state), not the preposition 'off'.
common.never: Generic value meaning 'this never expires/never happened' (e.g. in a date field), not an imperative.

columns.providerLocal: Shown in the Provider column for a user who signs in with username/password rather than SSO.
columns.mfa: Column header; MFA = Multi-Factor Authentication status for the user.

roles.system: Role label for an automated/internal system account, not a reference to system settings.

validation.passwordMinLength: Fragment concatenated into passwordMustContain's {{requirements}} list (e.g. 'at least 8 characters'); keep it a phrase that reads naturally in a list.
validation.passwordMustContain: {{requirements}} is a comma-joined list built from the passwordMinLength/Uppercase/Lowercase/Number/Special fragments above.

deleteUser.confirmation: Contains an HTML <strong> tag around {{username}}; keep the tag, translate only the surrounding words.

detail.mfaEnabled: {{types}} lists the enabled MFA method names (e.g. 'Authenticator, Email'), not a data type.
detail.created: Refers to when the API key was created, not account/user creation.
detail.lastUsed: Refers to when the API key was last used, not general last activity.

columns.cracked: Column header; shows the count of hashes already cracked for this client (not an action to mark something cracked).

form.cloudInherit: {{state}} is filled from cloudEnabledWord/cloudDisabledWord ('enabled'/'disabled'); {{amount}} is a dollar budget number; {{period}} is a billing period word (e.g. 'month').
form.cloudEnabledWord: Lowercase fragment inserted mid-sentence into cloudInherit as the {{state}} value.
form.cloudDisabledWord: Lowercase fragment inserted mid-sentence into cloudInherit as the {{state}} value.

columns.total: Column header for the client's total hash count (key is named 'total' but the shown label is 'Hashes').

detail.excluded: Status value shown next to 'Global potfile' / 'Client potfile' indicating this client's cracks are NOT stored there.
detail.included: Status value shown next to 'Global potfile' / 'Client potfile' indicating this client's cracks ARE stored there.

stats.active: {{count}} active — qualifier shown next to the Jobs stat, counting currently-running jobs.

bulkAssign.fallbackTeamName: Generic lowercase fallback word used in place of a real team name when the name isn't available; fits mid-sentence.

filterForm.regexLabel: 'RE2' is the name of the regex engine used (Google's RE2) — do not translate it.
filterForm.requiredClasses: 'Character classes' = categories of characters (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special) listed just below, not programming or school classes.
filterForm.previewLabel: {{countDisplay}} is the estimated number of matching words; {{rateDisplay}} is the percentage of the sampled wordlist that matched.

filtered.plaintextChip: Chip meaning the wordlist file itself is uncompressed/plain-text format — unrelated to a cracked 'plaintext' password.
filtered.regeneratingTooltip: 'Parent' here means the same thing as 'source wordlist' elsewhere — the original list this filtered list was derived from.

delete.cascadeTitle: 'Cascade deletion' means deleting this wordlist also deletes everything that depends on it (jobs, preset jobs, workflow steps), listed below.

tabs.john: Short tab label for 'John the Ripper' (a password-cracking tool) — not the first name John.

status.ready: Status chip meaning the rule file finished processing and can be used in jobs, distinct from 'Verified' (syntax-checked).

delete.cascadeTitle: 'Cascade deletion' means deleting this rule file also deletes everything that depends on it (jobs, preset jobs, workflow steps), listed below.

columns.keyspace: Keyspace = the total number of password candidates this job will try (a hashcat term), not a storage/disk space.

fields.cloudBurstEnabled: 'Cloud burst' = temporarily renting cloud GPU instances when the on-prem agent fleet is full.
fields.mask: Same hashcat 'mask' concept as maskPattern above — just the field label used in this attack mode's section.

straight.name: Hashcat attack-mode name (mode 0: use wordlist words unmodified) — not the geometric/direct sense of 'straight'.

combination.name: Hashcat attack-mode name (mode 1: concatenate words from two wordlists) — not a general 'combination'.

helperText.maskPatternExamples: ?l, ?u, ?d, ?s, ?a are literal hashcat mask syntax tokens — keep them unchanged; only the descriptive words may be localized.
helperText.cloudAllowCommunityHosts: Vast.ai, RunPod, and AWS are third-party cloud GPU providers' brand names — keep untranslated.
helperText.priority: {{maxPriority}} is the admin-configured maximum priority value (from System Settings), not a fixed number.

workflows.canInterrupt: Value shown in the Priority Mode column when this workflow may interrupt lower-priority jobs (pairs with 'Normal').
workflows.normal: Value shown in the Priority Mode column for a workflow that cannot interrupt other jobs (pairs with 'Can Interrupt').
workflows.loopbackAllEligible: Badge/value meaning every eligible step in this workflow has loopback re-runs turned on.

columns.highPriority: Column header for the workflow's priority/interrupt mode; shows 'Normal' or 'Can Interrupt'.
columns.loopback: 'Loopback' = a feature that re-runs mutation steps against only newly-cracked passwords until no more are found.

binaryManagement.default: Badge/label marking which binary is currently the default (not a 'reset to default' button).
binaryManagement.sourceUpload: Value shown in the Source column meaning this binary was added by file upload (not an 'Upload' button).

diagnostics.runtime: Section heading for Go runtime stats (CPUs, goroutines, memory) — not a duration/uptime value.
diagnostics.goroutines: 'Goroutines' = Go language's lightweight concurrent threads, a runtime metric (not a typo for 'routines').
diagnostics.heap: 'Heap' = memory allocated by the Go runtime's heap, as distinct from total OS memory ('System' below).
diagnostics.system: Total OS-reported memory, as distinct from the Go runtime 'Heap' above.
diagnostics.gcRuns: 'GC Runs' = number of Go garbage-collector cycles (an automatic memory-cleanup metric).
diagnostics.connections: Active PostgreSQL database connection count (not network or agent connections).
diagnostics.connected: Count of currently-connected agents, distinct from the database 'Connections' above.
diagnostics.withDebugStatus: Count of agents currently running with debug logging enabled.
diagnostics.level: Current server log verbosity level (e.g. Debug, Info, Warn).
diagnostics.buffer: Size/count of an agent's in-memory log buffer before it's flushed to a file.
diagnostics.filtered: Short qualifier appended to the 'Showing X of Y entries' message, e.g. '(filtered)', when a log-level filter is active.
diagnostics.truncated: Short qualifier appended to the 'Showing X of Y entries' message, e.g. '(truncated)', when log output was cut off.
diagnostics.total: Sum row across all log categories (Backend + Nginx + PostgreSQL) in the log-size table.
diagnostics.nginx: 'Nginx' is the web server's product name — keep untranslated (same for 'PostgreSQL').
diagnostics.confirmPurgeLogs: {{dirLabel}} is filled from 'allServerLogs' or 'directoryLogs' (e.g. 'all server logs' or 'nginx logs').
diagnostics.serverDebugModeTitle: {{action}} is filled with 'Enable' or 'Disable' from the keys below, forming e.g. 'Enable Server Debug Mode'.

accountSecurity.jwtExpiry: 'JWT' = JSON Web Token, the access-token format; keep the acronym untranslated.

teams.enableHelper: 'Default Team' is the system's built-in fallback team (a proper name), not a generic description.

webauthn.rpId: 'Relying Party' is a fixed WebAuthn/FIDO specification term for the service doing the authenticating, not a generic phrase.

providers.acsUrl: 'ACS' = SAML Assertion Consumer Service, the endpoint that receives the SSO response (a fixed technical term).

ldapConfig.baseDn: 'DN' = LDAP Distinguished Name, a technical identifier format, not a typo.
ldapConfig.useStartTls: 'StartTLS' is the protocol name for upgrading a plain LDAP connection to encrypted — keep it untranslated.

samlConfig.spEntityId: 'SP' = Service Provider (this application); the 'IdP' fields below = Identity Provider (the external SSO system).

warnings.ephemeralKeyEnvExample: Literal .env file syntax; keep 'SSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY=' and the <angle-bracket> placeholder syntax as-is.

labels.domain: The sending domain registered with the email provider (e.g. Mailgun), not a generic company/website domain.

helpers.mailgunFromEmail: 'yourdomain' is illustrative example text, not a real placeholder — keep it as a generic example.

menuItems.firstCrack: Notification template sent when the very first password in a job/hashlist gets cracked.

agentOverflow.priorityFifoMode: 'FIFO' = First In, First Out — the oldest job is served first; a scheduling term often left untranslated.
agentOverflow.tooltip: 'max_agents' refers to the literal Max Agents setting/column name (snake_case used intentionally), not a typo.

potfile.passwordsEvery: Sentence fragment combined with numbers elsewhere to read e.g. '500 passwords every 60 seconds' — not a complete phrase on its own.

priorityInfo.large: Intentionally informal/humorous tone ('ridiculous workload') — keep playful if natural in the target language, or soften if not.

chunking.defaultChunkDurationHelper: 'scheduler-v2' is the internal name of the task-scheduling subsystem — keep it as-is, don't translate.
chunking.minChunkSecondsHelper: 'Wall time' = real-world elapsed time (wall-clock time), as opposed to CPU time.

jobControl.keyspaceTimeoutHelper: '--keyspace' and '--total-candidates' are literal hashcat command-line flag names — do not translate them.

scheduler.taskStartupGraceHelper: 'Autotune' = hashcat's automatic GPU kernel-tuning step at startup, a technical term often left untranslated.

potfile.enableClientPotfilesHelper: 'Pot-file' here is the same concept as 'Potfile' written elsewhere in this file — spelling varies in the source, no difference in meaning.

loopback.title: Heading for the loopback feature: re-running mutation steps against only newly-cracked passwords until no more are found.

scheduling.jobInterruptionHelper: 'Preemption' = forcibly interrupting a lower-priority running job to free up its agents (a scheduling term).
